name: Skin laxity and sagging
summary: Reduced elasticity means the skin no longer holds the same contours as closely as it once did, particularly through the cheeks, jawline and neck.
statement: Reduced elasticity means the skin *no longer holds the same contours* as closely as it once did, particularly through the cheeks, jawline and neck.
happening: Skin holds its shape through a combination of structural support beneath it and its own elasticity. As both decline together, skin no longer sits as closely to the tissue beneath it, and gravity has a more visible effect. Laxity is usually assessed alongside the structural changes that accompany it, rather than treated as a surface concern alone.

factors.title: Gradual structural change
factors.text: Skin laxity and sagging typically develop gradually beneath the surface, which is why they are often noticed later than they began.

factors.title: Individual rate of change
factors.text: The pace at which skin laxity and sagging progress varies between patients, shaped by genetics, lifestyle and skin type.

factors.title: Compounding factors
factors.text: Skin laxity and sagging rarely occur in isolation, and are usually assessed alongside related structural changes nearby.

recommendedText: Considered as a primary option for skin laxity, tightening the tissue beneath the surface where reduced elasticity is the main concern.
alongsideText: Often assessed alongside, since these concerns frequently share the same treatment options.

steps.title: Assessment first
steps.text: We assess laxity alongside the structural changes beneath it, rather than as a surface concern alone.

steps.title: Depth before surface
steps.text: Where the tissue beneath the skin has loosened, tightening at that level is usually considered first.

steps.title: A course, not a session
steps.text: Tightening builds gradually, so treatment is usually planned as a course with time between sessions.

steps.title: Ongoing review
steps.text: Elasticity keeps changing with time, so the plan is reviewed at follow-up and adjusted as needed.
